title: Sainsbury’s launches new AI-powered shopping tool
key_facts: Sainsbury's is launching SmartLists in its app
Customers create lists by typing or taking a photo
Lists are matched to real products including Nectar Prices
Items can be added straight to the trolley for online orders
Unified Sainsbury's app with the S logo merges online grocery, ChopChop, SmartLists, SmartShop and Nectar
Director of product Ben Edge quoted
quote_evidence: “SmartLists” lets customers create shopping lists by typing or taking a photo of what they need.
Items can then be added straight to the trolley for online orders.
why_it_matters_hint: A UK supermarket adds AI list-to-basket matching inside one combined app.
notes: Retail Week page (chunk link) returned 405; read at Decision Marketing, which carries the Sainsbury's announcement. Sainsbury's own press release exists on corporate.sainsburys.co.uk but was not readable.
